description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Trigger Your turn begins.

Your Feral Bond's initiative changes to your own for the remainder of the encounter. It takes its turn immediately after yours on that shared count, and continues to do so each round.

cinderfall.incomplete: Initiative-order reassignment for a second actor is combat-tracker state, not actor data a rule element can rewrite; the one real pf2e subsystem where two actors share a single turn (Summoner/Eidolon) does so via hardcoded system support specific to that class, not a generic rule element other classes/companions can adopt. This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
